title: The Will That Vanished
subtitle: A Fortune Lost, A Mystery Unfolds
summary: When Rameswarbabu, a wealthy and witty patriarch, pulls off what may be his last great joke, Byomkesh Bakshi is drawn into a web of intrigue surrounding a missing will. As old friendships and deeper secrets surface, the search for the vanished document becomes a race against time—and a puzzle only Byomkesh can hope to solve.
